title: stenotaphrum sarmentosum
intro: Stenotaphrum sarmentosum, commonly known as Bermuda grass, is a type of warm-season grass native to Africa and Asia, often used as a groundcover or for erosion control. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Stenotaphrum sarmentosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
